## Language Choice (6 points)
Choose one answer for each question.
**3.** Sam Nilsson is writing a formal e-mail to Ms. Lind. Which complete closing follows the class model? (1 point)
A. Sincerely,
Sam Nilsson
B. Yours faithfully,
Sam Nilsson
C. Yours sincerely,
Sam
Correct answer: <i>A. Sincerely,</i>
<i>Sam Nilsson</i>
